examples.text_en: He was despondent after the loss of the game.
examples.text_zh: 比赛失利后他十分丧气。

examples.text_en: The despondent team had no hope of a win.
examples.text_zh: 这支失望的队伍没有获胜的希望。

examples.text_en: The despot will take the land and the gold.
examples.text_zh: 这个专制君主会夺走土地和黄金。

examples.text_en: People know the despot and his hard heart.
examples.text_zh: 人们都知道这个暴君和他冷酷的心肠。

examples.text_en: The despotic king had no love for his people.
examples.text_zh: 这个专制的国王不爱他的子民。

examples.text_en: They live under a despotic kind of power.
examples.text_zh: 他们生活在一个专制的权力之下。

examples.text_en: The country was in despotism after the war.
examples.text_zh: 战后这个国家陷入了专制统治。

examples.text_en: Despotism can take the power from the people.
examples.text_zh: 专制会从人民手中夺走权力。

examples.text_en: The destitute family had no food or home.
examples.text_zh: 这个穷困的家庭没有食物，也没有家。

examples.text_en: He was destitute after the loss of his work.
examples.text_zh: 失去工作后他一贫如洗。

examples.text_en: The destitution of the town was a big problem.
examples.text_zh: 这座小镇的穷困是个大问题。

examples.text_en: They live in destitution for a long time.
examples.text_zh: 他们长期生活在贫穷之中。

examples.text_en: This cheap toy is not destructible at all.
examples.text_zh: 这个便宜的玩具一点也不容易坏。

examples.text_en: The box is made of destructible paper.
examples.text_zh: 这个盒子是用易损的纸做成的。

examples.text_en: His work was slow and desultory.
examples.text_zh: 他的工作进展缓慢而散漫。

examples.text_en: We had a desultory talk about the weather.
examples.text_zh: 我们随意地聊了聊天气。

examples.text_en: You can detach the key from the ring.
examples.text_zh: 你可以把钥匙从钥匙圈上取下来。

examples.text_en: Please detach the last page of this form.
examples.text_zh: 请把这张表格的最后一页撕下来。

examples.text_en: He seemed calm and rather detached.
examples.text_zh: 他看起来很平静，而且相当超然。

examples.text_en: The house stands apart, quiet and detached.
examples.text_zh: 这栋房子独立而安静。

examples.text_en: The change was barely detectable to us.
examples.text_zh: 这一变化我们几乎察觉不到。

examples.text_en: A slight smell was detectable in the room.
examples.text_zh: 房间里能闻到一股轻微的气味。

examples.text_en: The detection of the problem was a great help.
examples.text_zh: 发现这个问题帮了大忙。

examples.text_en: They work on the detection of each problem.
examples.text_zh: 他们致力于探测每一个问题。

examples.text_en: The metal detector beeped near the door.
examples.text_zh: 金属探测器在门附近响了起来。

examples.text_en: This smoke detector needs a new battery.
examples.text_zh: 这个烟雾探测器需要换新电池。

examples.text_en: The law can deter people from bad work.
examples.text_zh: 法律能制止人们做坏事。

examples.text_en: A strong wall can deter the other team.
examples.text_zh: 一道坚固的墙能震慑对方队伍。

examples.text_en: We noticed a clear deterioration in his health.
examples.text_zh: 我们注意到他的健康明显恶化。

examples.text_en: The building shows signs of steady deterioration.
examples.text_zh: 这栋楼显出逐渐恶化的迹象。

examples.text_en: Money is a key determinant of our choices.
examples.text_zh: 金钱是我们做选择的一个关键因素。

examples.text_en: Price is the main determinant of demand here.
examples.text_zh: 价格是这里需求的主要决定因素。

examples.text_en: The law is a strong deterrent to bad work.
examples.text_zh: 法律是对坏事的有力威慑。

examples.text_en: They need a deterrent for the other team.
examples.text_zh: 他们需要一种能震慑对方队伍的手段。

examples.text_en: Such bad work is detestable to most people.
examples.text_zh: 这样的坏事对大多数人来说都很可恶。

examples.text_en: The detestable act was a problem for all.
examples.text_zh: 这可憎的行为对所有人来说都是个问题。

examples.text_en: The people rose up to dethrone the king.
examples.text_zh: 人民奋起废黜了国王。

examples.text_en: They tried to dethrone him in a quiet way.
examples.text_zh: 他们试图悄悄地把他赶下王位。

examples.text_en: The loud detonation shook the small street.
examples.text_zh: 巨大的爆炸声震动了这条小街。

examples.text_en: We heard a distant detonation at night.
examples.text_zh: 夜里我们听到远处传来一声爆炸。

examples.text_en: These small faults detract from its true value.
examples.text_zh: 这些小缺点有损它真正的价值。

examples.text_en: One mistake should not detract from your good work.
examples.text_zh: 一个错误不应该贬低你出色的工作。

examples.text_en: The detraction of his work was not right.
examples.text_zh: 对他作品的贬低是不对的。

examples.text_en: Such detraction can break a good name.
examples.text_zh: 这样的贬损会败坏一个好名声。

examples.text_en: Smoking is a detriment to your health.
examples.text_zh: 吸烟对你的健康有害。

examples.text_en: He works long hours to the detriment of his family.
examples.text_zh: 他长时间工作，损害了家庭。

examples.text_en: Too much sugar is detrimental to your teeth.
examples.text_zh: 糖吃太多对牙齿有害。

examples.text_en: The new rules proved detrimental to small firms.
examples.text_zh: 新规定对小公司有害。

examples.text_en: Rocks and detritus covered the dry river bed.
examples.text_zh: 岩石和碎石覆盖着干涸的河床。

examples.text_en: The storm left detritus all over the road.
examples.text_zh: 暴风雨把碎石留得满路都是。

examples.text_en: The war brought devastation to the small country.
examples.text_zh: 战争给这个小国带来了破坏。

examples.text_en: We saw the devastation caused by the storm.
examples.text_zh: 我们看到了暴风雨造成的破坏。

examples.text_en: His deviant act was a problem for the group.
examples.text_zh: 他的反常行为对这群人来说是个问题。

examples.text_en: They watch the deviant man with great care.
examples.text_zh: 他们十分谨慎地注视着这个行为反常的人。

examples.text_en: They deviate from the plan in a bad way.
examples.text_zh: 他们以糟糕的方式偏离了计划。

examples.text_en: We must not deviate from the true line.
examples.text_zh: 我们绝不能偏离正确的路线。

examples.text_en: The deviation from the plan was easy to see.
examples.text_zh: 对计划的背离很容易看出。

examples.text_en: There was a small deviation in the road.
examples.text_zh: 路上有一处小小的偏离。

examples.text_en: We drove along a devious mountain road.
examples.text_zh: 我们沿着一条迂回的山路行驶。

examples.text_en: He took a devious path through the woods.
examples.text_zh: 他走了一条穿过树林的迂回小路。

examples.text_en: They will devise a new plan for the work.
examples.text_zh: 他们将设计一项新的工作计划。

examples.text_en: She can devise a good way to use the land.
examples.text_zh: 她能设计出利用这片土地的好办法。

examples.text_en: The government will devolve power to each town.
examples.text_zh: 政府将把权力下放给各个城镇。

examples.text_en: They devolve the work to the small groups.
examples.text_zh: 他们把工作下放给各个小组。

examples.text_en: She is a real devotee of classical music.
examples.text_zh: 她是古典音乐的真正爱好者。

examples.text_en: Every devotee waited outside the small theater.
examples.text_zh: 每个爱好者都在小剧院外等候。

examples.text_en: Her devotion to the work was clear to all.
examples.text_zh: 她对工作的投入众人都看在眼里。

examples.text_en: His devotion to his family was very strong.
examples.text_zh: 他对家庭的热爱非常深厚。

examples.text_en: He read a short devotional poem each morning.
examples.text_zh: 他每天早上读一首简短的虔诚诗。

examples.text_en: The choir sang a quiet devotional song.
examples.text_zh: 唱诗班唱了一首安静的虔诚歌曲。

examples.text_en: The devout man will go to the church each day.
examples.text_zh: 这个虔诚的人每天都会去教堂。

examples.text_en: She was a devout person with a kind heart.
examples.text_zh: 她是个心地善良的虔诚之人。

examples.text_en: The grass was wet with morning dew.
examples.text_zh: 草地上沾着晨露。

examples.text_en: Dew formed on the leaves during the night.
examples.text_zh: 夜里叶子上结起了露水。

examples.text_en: The dexterous girl can do this work well.
examples.text_zh: 这个灵巧的女孩能把这项工作做得很好。

examples.text_en: He was dexterous with the ball and the card.
examples.text_zh: 他玩球和纸牌都很灵巧。

examples.text_en: He has diabetes and must watch his diet.
examples.text_zh: 他有糖尿病，必须注意饮食。

examples.text_en: Daily walks help people with diabetes stay well.
examples.text_zh: 每天散步有助于糖尿病人保持健康。

examples.text_en: They saw a diabolic act in the dark night.
examples.text_zh: 他们在黑夜里看到了一桩恶魔般的行为。

examples.text_en: Such a diabolic plan can not be right.
examples.text_zh: 这样恶毒的计划不可能是对的。

examples.text_en: He gave a diabolical laugh in the dark.
examples.text_zh: 他在黑暗中发出恶魔般的笑声。

examples.text_en: The plan was clever but truly diabolical.
examples.text_zh: 这个计划很巧妙，但确实邪恶。

examples.text_en: The diagnosis was clear after the long test.
examples.text_zh: 经过漫长的检查，诊断结果很明确。

examples.text_en: We must wait for the diagnosis of the problem.
examples.text_zh: 我们必须等待对问题的诊断。

examples.text_en: They ran a diagnostic test on the engine.
examples.text_zh: 他们对发动机做了诊断测试。

examples.text_en: This tool is useful for diagnostic work.
examples.text_zh: 这个工具对诊断工作很有用。

examples.text_en: Draw a diagonal line across the square.
examples.text_zh: 在这个正方形上画一条对角线。

examples.text_en: The board has a long diagonal crack.
examples.text_zh: 这块木板有一条长长的斜裂缝。

examples.text_en: His diatribe against the plan was very long.
examples.text_zh: 他对这项计划的抨击非常冗长。

examples.text_en: We hear a diatribe about the state of the world.
examples.text_zh: 我们听到一段关于世界现状的抨击。

examples.text_en: The actor's clear diction pleased the audience.
examples.text_zh: 这位演员清晰的吐字让观众很满意。

examples.text_en: Good diction makes a speech easy to follow.
examples.text_zh: 好的措辞让演讲容易听懂。

examples.text_en: He often quoted a wise dictum about patience.
examples.text_zh: 他常常引用一句关于耐心的格言。

examples.text_en: That dictum still guides my daily work.
examples.text_zh: 那句格言至今指引着我的日常工作。

examples.text_en: The book is didactic and full of rules.
examples.text_zh: 这本书训诫意味浓厚，满是规矩。

examples.text_en: His didactic words were a help to the young team.
examples.text_zh: 他教诲的话对这支年轻的队伍很有帮助。

examples.text_en: Only a few diehard fans stayed to the end.
examples.text_zh: 只有少数铁杆粉丝留到了最后。

examples.text_en: He is a diehard supporter of this team.
examples.text_zh: 他是这支队伍的铁杆支持者。

examples.text_en: She has a dietary plan for her health.
examples.text_zh: 她为健康制定了一份饮食计划。

examples.text_en: Each dietary need can change with age.
examples.text_zh: 每种饮食需求都会随着年龄而变化。

examples.text_en: The dieter will not eat that kind of food.
examples.text_zh: 节食者不会吃那种食物。

examples.text_en: A dieter must watch the food on the table.
examples.text_zh: 节食者必须留意桌上的食物。

examples.text_en: She will study dietetics at the university.
examples.text_zh: 她将在大学学习饮食学。

examples.text_en: Dietetics can help people eat in a better way.
examples.text_zh: 饮食学能帮助人们更合理地进食。

examples.text_en: The dietitian will help him plan his food.
examples.text_zh: 营养学家会帮他安排饮食。

examples.text_en: She will go to a dietitian for help.
examples.text_zh: 她将去看营养学家寻求帮助。

examples.text_en: We must differentiate good gold from bad gold.
examples.text_zh: 我们必须把好金子和坏金子区分开来。

examples.text_en: They can differentiate the real from the bad.
examples.text_zh: 他们能区分真的和坏的。

examples.text_en: The diffident boy was still in class.
examples.text_zh: 这个羞怯的男孩在课上很安静。

examples.text_en: She was diffident about her own work.
examples.text_zh: 她对自己的工作缺乏自信。

examples.text_en: The good news began to diffuse through the town.
examples.text_zh: 好消息开始在小镇里传开。

examples.text_en: A soft light seemed to diffuse across the room.
examples.text_zh: 柔和的光似乎在房间里弥漫开来。

examples.text_en: The diffusion of the news was very fast.
examples.text_zh: 这条消息的传播非常快。

examples.text_en: We study the diffusion of light in the air.
examples.text_zh: 我们研究光在空气中的扩散。

examples.text_en: The food was good for his digestive system.
examples.text_zh: 这种食物对他的消化系统有好处。

examples.text_en: She has a digestive problem and must rest.
examples.text_zh: 她有消化方面的毛病，必须休息。

examples.text_en: The last digit of the number was not clear.
examples.text_zh: 这个数字的最后一位不清楚。

examples.text_en: Each digit in the code must be right.
examples.text_zh: 代码中的每一位数字都必须正确。

examples.text_en: I won't dignify that silly question with an answer.
examples.text_zh: 我不会用回答来抬举那个愚蠢的问题。

examples.text_en: A kind word can dignify the simplest task.
examples.text_zh: 一句善意的话能让最简单的工作变得体面。

examples.text_en: The dignitary will meet the people in the town.
examples.text_zh: 这位高官将在镇上会见民众。

examples.text_en: A dignitary will come to the school for the game.
examples.text_zh: 一位要人将来到学校观看比赛。

examples.text_en: Let us not digress from the main point.
examples.text_zh: 我们不要偏离要点。

examples.text_en: He tends to digress when he tells stories.
examples.text_zh: 他讲故事时容易跑题。

examples.text_en: His digression about the war was very long.
examples.text_zh: 他那段关于战争的离题话非常冗长。

examples.text_en: We must stop this digression and go back.
examples.text_zh: 我们必须停止这段离题，回到正题。

examples.text_en: Time and rain will slowly dilapidate the walls.
examples.text_zh: 时间和雨水会慢慢使这些墙破败。

examples.text_en: Nothing could dilapidate that strong stone gate.
examples.text_zh: 没有什么能让那座坚固的石门荒废。

examples.text_en: They lived in a dilapidated farm house.
examples.text_zh: 他们住在一栋破旧的农舍里。

examples.text_en: The dilapidated bridge is no longer safe.
examples.text_zh: 这座破旧的桥已经不安全了。

examples.text_en: The house was in a state of dilapidation.
examples.text_zh: 这房子处于破损不堪的状态。

examples.text_en: They complained about the dilapidation of the school.
examples.text_zh: 他们抱怨学校的破败。

examples.text_en: The small ball will dilate in the hot air.
examples.text_zh: 这个小球在热空气中会膨胀。

examples.text_en: They dilate the story with a few more words.
examples.text_zh: 他们用几句话把这个故事展开叙述。

examples.text_en: His dilatory way can make the team late.
examples.text_zh: 他拖拉的作风会让整个队伍迟到。

examples.text_en: The dilatory work was a problem for the group.
examples.text_zh: 这种拖拉的工作对这群人来说是个问题。

examples.text_en: He is a dilettante in the world of art.
examples.text_zh: 他在艺术界只是个业余爱好者。

examples.text_en: The dilettante will talk but will not work.
examples.text_zh: 这个业余爱好者只会空谈，不肯实干。

examples.text_en: She worked diligently on her report all night.
examples.text_zh: 她整晚都在勤奋地写报告。

examples.text_en: The students studied diligently for the final test.
examples.text_zh: 学生们为期末考试勤奋学习。

examples.text_en: They will dilute the water with a small cup.
examples.text_zh: 他们会用一个小杯子把水稀释。

examples.text_en: She can dilute the gold with water.
examples.text_zh: 她可以用水把金子稀释。

examples.text_en: The dilution of the water was easy to see.
examples.text_zh: 这水的稀释很容易看出。

examples.text_en: They talk about the dilution of the gold.
examples.text_zh: 他们谈论黄金的稀释。

examples.text_en: The dimension of the room was not very big.
examples.text_zh: 这个房间的尺寸不算很大。

examples.text_en: Each dimension of the box was on the card.
examples.text_zh: 盒子的每一维尺寸都写在卡片上。

examples.text_en: They found a three dimensional form in the box.
examples.text_zh: 他们在盒子里发现了一个三维的形状。

examples.text_en: A two dimensional plan is easy to read.
examples.text_zh: 二维的平面图很容易看懂。

examples.text_en: The music had a diminuendo near the end.
examples.text_zh: 这段音乐在接近结尾处有渐弱。

examples.text_en: We hear a diminuendo in the last part.
examples.text_zh: 我们在最后一部分听到了渐弱。

examples.text_en: The diminution of the water was a problem.
examples.text_zh: 水量的减少是个问题。

examples.text_en: There was a diminution in the value of gold.
examples.text_zh: 黄金的价值出现了降低。

examples.text_en: A diminutive figure stood at the gate.
examples.text_zh: 一个矮小的身影站在门口。

examples.text_en: The diminutive dog barked at the big cat.
examples.text_zh: 那只小个子狗冲着大猫叫。

examples.text_en: The room was dimly lit by one lamp.
examples.text_zh: 房间里只有一盏灯，光线昏暗。

examples.text_en: I could dimly see a figure in the fog.
examples.text_zh: 我隐约看见雾中有个人影。

examples.text_zh: 她脸上有一个小酒窝。

examples.text_en: The boy had a dimple on each side.
examples.text_zh: 这个男孩两边脸颊各有一个酒窝。

examples.text_zh: 路上传来的喧嚣很大。

examples.text_en: We could not hear over the din of the group.
examples.text_zh: 人群的喧闹让我们听不清。

examples.text_en: We will dine at a small restaurant tonight.
examples.text_zh: 今晚我们将在一家小餐馆用餐。

examples.text_en: They often dine together on quiet evenings.
examples.text_zh: 他们常在安静的夜晚一起用餐。

examples.text_zh: 他们在车站附近租了一间昏暗的房间。

examples.text_en: The walls were dingy and the floor was cold.
examples.text_zh: 墙壁昏暗，地板冰冷。

examples.text_en: The diocesan office closed for the holiday.
examples.text_zh: 主教管区的办公室放假关门了。

examples.text_en: He attended a diocesan meeting last week.
examples.text_zh: 他上周参加了主教管区的会议。

examples.text_zh: 那些文凭挂在办公室的墙上。

examples.text_en: She has two diplomas from the state university.
examples.text_zh: 她有两张文凭，都来自州立大学。

examples.text_zh: 他的嗜酒症慢慢毁掉了他的健康和家庭。

examples.text_en: Doctors once used that term for dipsomania.
examples.text_zh: 医生曾用那个词来指嗜酒症。

examples.text_zh: 唱诗班为逝者唱了一首缓慢的挽歌。

examples.text_en: A sad dirge filled the quiet church.
examples.text_zh: 一首悲伤的挽歌回荡在安静的教堂里。

examples.text_zh: 让我纠正你那个错误的想法。

examples.text_zh: 她试着消除他的恐惧。

examples.text_en: The new rules may disaffect many young members.
examples.text_zh: 新规定可能会让许多年轻成员离心。

examples.text_zh: 法官可能会驳回那个问题。

examples.text_en: School rules disallow phones during class.
examples.text_zh: 校规不允许上课时使用手机。

examples.text_en: She shook her head in clear disapproval.
examples.text_zh: 她明确地摇头表示不赞成。

examples.text_en: His parents showed strong disapproval of the plan.
examples.text_zh: 他父母对这个计划表示强烈反对。

examples.text_en: They disapprove of the new law in the town.
examples.text_zh: 他们不赞成镇上的这条新法律。

examples.text_en: We disapprove of the act and the plan.
examples.text_zh: 我们不赞成这一行为和这个计划。

examples.text_en: The guards tried to disarm the young man.
examples.text_zh: 警卫们试图解除那个年轻人的武装。

examples.text_en: Her warm smile could disarm any angry guest.
examples.text_zh: 她温暖的笑容能化解任何愤怒客人的怒意。

examples.text_en: The strong wind will disarrange your neat hair.
examples.text_zh: 大风会弄乱你整齐的头发。

examples.text_en: Please don't disarrange the papers on my desk.
examples.text_zh: 请不要弄乱我桌上的文件。

examples.text_en: The news left the group in disarray.
examples.text_zh: 这个消息使这群人陷入了混乱。

examples.text_en: They disarray the room and leave the house.
examples.text_zh: 他们把房间弄得乱七八糟便离开了房子。

examples.text_en: The group will disavow any link to the attack.
examples.text_zh: 该团体将否认与这次袭击有任何关联。

examples.text_en: He chose to disavow his earlier statement.
examples.text_zh: 他选择否认自己先前的说法。

examples.text_en: The court will disbar him for his bad work.
examples.text_zh: 法庭将因他的恶劣行径剥夺他的律师资格。

examples.text_en: They disbar a man who will break the law.
examples.text_zh: 他们剥夺违法之人的律师资格。

examples.text_en: The bank will disburse the funds next week.
examples.text_zh: 银行将在下周发放这笔资金。

examples.text_en: They must disburse the money before Friday.
examples.text_zh: 他们必须在周五之前支付这笔钱。

examples.text_en: We could discern a small house near the sea.
examples.text_zh: 我们能辨认出海边的一座小房子。

examples.text_en: They discern the truth from a few small words.
examples.text_zh: 他们从几个小词中辨明了真相。

examples.text_en: There was no discernible change in his mood.
examples.text_zh: 他的情绪没有明显的变化。

examples.text_en: A faint smell was discernible near the door.
examples.text_zh: 门附近能闻到一股淡淡的气味。

examples.text_en: The discerning man saw the truth at once.
examples.text_zh: 这个有眼力的人一眼就看出了真相。

examples.text_en: She has a discerning way with good art.
examples.text_zh: 她对优秀的艺术很有鉴赏力。
